questions.prompt: The host asks someone to read the opening announcement to the whole room. You…

options.text: Quietly hope someone else volunteers.
Would do it if nobody else wants to.
Happily put your hand up.
Are already standing on a chair.

questions.prompt: At a party you most enjoy being…

options.text: In a small side conversation.
Part of a lively group, not leading it.
One of the people keeping the energy up.
The person everyone is gathered around.

questions.prompt: Your character card suggests an accent and a signature catchphrase. You…

options.text: Would rather just be myself with a new name.
Might try the catchphrase once or twice.
Would commit to it for most of the night.
Would rehearse it in the car on the way over.

questions.prompt: Costume instructions arrive. You plan to…

options.text: Wear what I'd normally wear.
Add one themed item.
Put together a proper outfit.
Build the full look, props included.

questions.prompt: Someone asks your character a question your character must not answer truthfully. You'd feel…

options.text: Uncomfortable; I'd rather never have to lie.
Fine with a small fib if it's written for me.
Happy to bluff my way through.
Delighted; keeping a straight face is my favourite part.

questions.prompt: In card games that involve bluffing, you are usually…

options.text: Caught out immediately.
Okay, if nobody looks at me too closely.
Pretty convincing.
The one nobody trusts.

questions.prompt: A torn letter is found under a cushion. You…

options.text: Let someone else deal with it.
Have a look if it's passed to me.
Try to piece it together.
Photograph it, make notes and compare handwriting.

questions.prompt: By the end of the night, how much do you care about solving it?

options.text: Not much; I'm here for the company.
It'd be nice to guess right.
I really want to work it out.
I will not rest until I've cracked it.

questions.prompt: You learn a juicy secret about another character. You…

options.text: Keep it to myself.
Mention it to one trusted person.
Use it to bargain for information.
Drop hints in public just to watch the chaos.

questions.prompt: A secret mission says to distract the room for two minutes. You…

options.text: Would skip it.
Would do something low-key.
Would come up with a convincing diversion.
Would cause a scene they'll talk about for years.

questions.prompt: Before the party, how much would you read or prepare?

options.text: As close to nothing as possible.
A short summary on the day.
A proper read a few days before.
Everything, twice, with notes.

questions.prompt: If your character had tasks that kept you busy all night, you'd feel…

options.text: Overwhelmed; I'd prefer a light role.
Fine with a couple of tasks.
Glad to have plenty to do.
Disappointed if there were any quiet moments.
